description: Signals logged live when they fired, never backfilled, with the price after. view: recent (default: the latest signals and their outcomes), record (the last N firings of one type on one coin: how many rose, median move), scorecard (the totals only).

coin.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC. A pair like ETH/USD works too.

cursor.description: Next page: the cursor from the previous answer.

detail.description: brief (default): the answer, key numbers and top rows. full: every row, paged with cursor.

hours.description: How many hours back to read.

limit.description: Rows to return (usually up to 500; more is clamped and said).

type.description: Signal type; an unknown one lists the valid types.

name: signals

access_note.description: What this connection could not return.

available.description: False: no data; note says why.

title: Signal track record
